items.title: 4. Soil Degradation and Plant Life Damage (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: 4. Soil Degradation and Plant Life Damage: a main subheading of 33.5 Effect of Water Pollution on the Environment, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 255-255.

blocks.text: Pani ki pollution mitti ko kharab (soil degradation) karti aur paudon ko nuqsan deti hai. Heavy metals, industrial waste aur excessive nutrients mitti mein seep ho kar (ris kar) us ka structure (banawat) aur fertility (zarkhezi) badal dete hain. Jama hue chemicals mitti ki natural microbial activity (microbes ka kaam) bigarte hain, jo paudon ki sehat ke liye zaroori hai. Polluted pani lagne se paude chhote reh jate hain (stunted growth), leaf discoloration (patton ka rang badalna) hota hai, aur paude mar bhi sakte hain.
